chapter.verse: Tanglai hunin Pasian in kamsangte' tungtawnin lam tuamtuam tawh hun tamveipi sung i pupite na hopih hi.
Tu-a hunleni a nunungte ah ahihleh Pasian in Tapa' tungtawnin eite hong hopih khinzo hi. Tua Tapa pen na khempeuh a luah dinga a seh hi a, a om vannuai a piansak zong tua Tapa' tungtawn ahi hi.

Amah pen Pasian' minphatna vangtaang leh Pasian' pianzia muhtheihna lim zong hi a, amah in vanglian ama' kammal tawh na khempeuh huai hi. Mawhnate a siansuah khit ciangin a sangna mun Vanglianpi' taklam ah tu hi.
Vanmite' min sangin ama' luah min phazaw ahih mah bangin amah pen vanmite sangin lianzaw sangzaw hi.

A hang pen Pasian in vanmite a kua pen' tungah hih bangin ci ngei ahi hiam? “Nang pen ka Tapa na hi a, tuni-in nangma' pa ka suak hi.” Hih bangin zong ci ngei ahi hiam? “Kei ama' pa ka hiding a, amah ka tapa hiding hi.”
Leitung ah tua tacil hong tunpih ciangin zong hih bangin gen a, “Pasian' vanmite khempeuh in amah bia ta uh hen!”
a langkhat ah vanmite' thu hih bangin gen hi: “Amah in ama' vanmite huihnung bangin bawl a, ama' nasemte meikuang bangin bawl hi.”
Tapa tawh kisai-in ahihleh hih bangin gen hi: “Maw Pasian, nangma' kumpi-tokhom pen a tawntung a tawntungin kip a, thumaan thutang teipi pen na kumpigam na ukna teipi ahi hi.
Dikna thu na thupisak a, thukhun pampaihna na hua hi; Tua hangin Pasian in, nangma' Pasian in, sathau hong nilhin na kithuahpihte khengvalin nakpi nuamna sathau hong nilh hi.”
Hih bangin zong gen lai hi: “Topa aw, nangmah in a kipatcilin leitung khuambul na phut a, vantungte pen nangma' khutma ahi hi.
Tua nate kisia ding uh a, ahi zongin nang na om paisuak ding hi; tua nate a vekin puan bangin paat ding uh a,
nangmah in puantual tungsilh bangin zialin tua nate kikhel ding uh hi. Ahih hangin nang na kibang ding a, nangma' khankumte bei ngeilo ding hi.”
Tua mah bangin vanmi a kua pen' tungah hih bangin ci ngei ahi hiam? “Ka taklam ah hong tu in aw, na galte nang' ading khe-ngakna tokhom ka suahsak mateng maw.”
Vanmite cih pen hotkhiatna a luah ding mite a don dinga hong kisawlkhia, a vekun nasemhuh khate hilo uh ahi hiam?
